description: NESTED SUB-ASSEMBLY GOLDEN (ASM-A3 step 1): the revolute hinge golden (assembly-hinge-revolute: two 40 x 25 x 10 mm plates with r5 holes at (12, 12.5) and (28, 12.5), A grounded, B on a revolute joint through hole 1 driven to 90 deg) inserted TWICE as a rigid sub-assembly, plus a third plate C on a RIGID joint whose first origin is a part INSIDE the first hinge. W1 is grounded at the origin; W2 is grounded at (100, 50, 0) turned a quarter turn about Z; C is seeded at (200, 0, 0) and its rigid joint pairs the hole-1 TOP rim of W1's plate B (named by occurrence id, uuid5 of W1 then B) with C's hole-1 BOTTOM rim. Locks: the child solved in its own frame then moved as one body, the composition of the instance pose with each part's pose inside it, occurrence ids, a parent joint resolved on a nested part and carried into the sub-assembly frame, and a well-constrained closed-form solve.
derivation: Expectations are HAND-DERIVED, not recorded pipeline output. The plate's own mass properties are the sketch-extrude-plate-2holes golden's: volume 8429.203673205104 mm^3, surface_area 3614.159265358979 mm^2, centroid (20, 12.5, 5), AABB [0,0,0]..[40,25,10], 8 faces / 18 edges / 1 shell.
Inside each hinge (its own frame), from assembly-hinge-revolute: A at identity; B at t_B = (24.5, 0.5, 10), R_B = RotZ(+90 deg), q = (0, 0, 0.7071067811865476, 0.7071067811865476).

Occurrence ids: uuid5(W1, str(A)) = 8771d05f-6a43-5ec4-8284-596ca6133df0, uuid5(W1, str(B)) = e5ca6644-ab70-5fa8-996d-4d377f3aca35, uuid5(W2, str(A)) = d1d8f6d6-6c30-5c97-bb33-cb39cef2a402, uuid5(W2, str(B)) = 4ad756f9-611c-58ce-b836-325399af9c78 (W1 = ...f1, W2 = ...f2, A = ...01, B = ...02; loft_wire.assemblies.nested_occurrence_id).
W1 is grounded at identity, so W1/A is at identity and W1/B at (24.5, 0.5, 10), RotZ(90).

Rigid joint origin A (circle_centre, W1/B's hole-1 TOP rim, B-local (12, 12.5, 10), Z = +Z, X = +X). World: R_B (12, 12.5, 10) + t_B = (-12.5, 12, 10) + (24.5, 0.5, 10) = (12, 12.5, 20); Z = +Z; X = R_B (+X) = +Y.

Rigid joint origin B (circle_centre, C's hole-1 BOTTOM rim, C-local (12, 12.5, 0), Z = -Z, X = +X). The joint aligns F_C = F_A o RotX(180): world X = +Y, Z = -Z. So R_C (+X) = +Y and R_C (-Z) = -Z: R_C = RotZ(+90), q = (0, 0, 0.7071067811865476, 0.7071067811865476). t_C = (12, 12.5, 20) - R_C (12, 12.5, 0) = (12, 12.5, 20) - (-12.5, 12, 0) = (24.5, 0.5, 20): C sits on W1's B, 10 above it.

remaining_dof = 0: W1 and W2 are grounded (the parent solves each sub-assembly as one body, so the hinge's own free turn is not a DOF here) and the rigid joint fixes C, so the status is well_constrained.

Probes: C's hole-1 bottom centre (12, 12.5, 0) -> (12, 12.5, 20), the joint origin. W2/B's hole-1 bottom centre (12, 12.5, 0) -> RotZ(180) (12, 12.5, 0) + (99.5, 74.5, 10) = (87.5, 62, 10), which is W2/A's hole-1 top centre R_W (12, 12.5, 10) + t_W = (87.5, 62, 10): the hinge stayed closed when its instance turned.
combined topology 40 / 90 / 5 (summed over the five placed plates); distinct_mesh_count 1 (one part_key at both levels).
tolerance_rationale: CLOSED-FORM tolerance: each hinge is the closed-form hinge golden, and the parent is a tree hanging off grounded bodies, so every pose is analytic to float64 round-off. Measured first (2026-10-15, build123d 0.11.1 / OCCT 7.9, numpy BLAS pinned to 1 thread): every position within 3.6e-15 mm, quaternions within 1.2e-16, centroid within 4e-15 mm, bounding box within 3.6e-15 mm, combined volume within 1.5e-11 mm^3 (summation order of five part volumes). 1e-9 matches the S4a joint goldens. Loosening it requires a reviewed justification here and in docs/GEOMETRY-QA.md.

probes.note: C's hole-1 bottom centre lands on W1/B's hole-1 top centre (the rigid joint origin)
W2/B's hole-1 bottom centre stays on W2/A's hole-1 top centre: the turned hinge moved as one body
